title: Your body, system by system.

referenceStatus.pending: This catalog record is pending bibliographic verification. It is not a confirmed source.

confidenceMeaning.high: This describes how consolidated the catalog model is, not whether a source was checked.
confidenceMeaning.medium: This describes mixed or limited evidence in the catalog model, not bibliographic verification.
confidenceMeaning.low: This describes scarce or uncertain evidence in the catalog model, not bibliographic verification.

anatomySourceUnverified: Recorded link; verification of this source is not confirmed on this sheet.

recoveryDisclaimer: Orientative Soma catalog model. It is not a personal estimate or a medical timeline: real change depends on individual factors.
